description: Header file defining mathematical utility functions and constants for the ocudu namespace, including complex number operations, prime number calculations, bit reversal, and conversions between decibels and linear ratios.

methods.name: divide_ceil
methods.description: Performs integer division with rounding up, ensuring numerator and denominator are integers and denominator is not zero.

methods.name: divide_round
methods.description: Performs integer division with rounding to the nearest integer.

methods.name: pow2
methods.description: Calculates 2 raised to the given power.

methods.name: abs_sq
methods.description: Calculates the squared magnitude of a complex number.

methods.name: is_near_zero
methods.description: Checks if a float or complex value is near zero based on a small threshold.

methods.name: log2_ceil
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of log base 2 of an unsigned integer.

methods.name: convert_dB_to_amplitude
methods.description: Converts decibel value to linear amplitude ratio.

methods.name: convert_dB_to_power
methods.description: Converts decibel value to linear power ratio.

methods.name: convert_amplitude_to_dB
methods.description: Converts linear amplitude ratio to decibels.

methods.name: convert_power_to_dB
methods.description: Converts linear power ratio to decibels.

methods.name: prime_greater_than
methods.description: Finds the smallest prime number greater than n (up to 3299).

methods.name: prime_lower_than
methods.description: Finds the largest prime number less than n (up to 3299).

methods.name: reverse_byte
methods.description: Reverses the bits of a byte using a lookup table.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Calculates the least common multiple of a range of integers.
